verdict_reason: The three new MdmClient methods are mapped and the existing everyFeignMethod test enforces the mapping; only a Minor about the deleted transport-timing rationale having no docs home.

todos.issue: The class Javadoc that recorded why calls are timed at the Feign transport, not in MdmService (MdmClientInterceptor fetches the Trade token inside the MDM request, so service-level timing would add token time to MDM's figures), is deleted and the reasoning now has no home: the repo has no docs/ folder and nothing else states it. The next person to move timing into MdmService gets the token-time skew back.
todos.fix: Must: the reason ExternalCallFeignCapability times calls at the transport is stated in the repo's docs/ (or the behaviour spec), and nowhere in code. One way: add a short docs/observability.md (or a section in README.md) covering the external-call metric, why it is measured in a Feign Capability, and the operation names in ExternalCall.
